tooltip.kubejs.schema_cuivre.1: Blueprints for the Empire's fluid machines.
tooltip.kubejs.schema_cuivre.2: Stays in the crafting grid: never consumed.
tooltip.kubejs.schema_laiton.1: The secret of the imperial alloy.
tooltip.kubejs.schema_laiton.2: Lets you craft the blaze burner. Never consumed.
tooltip.kubejs.schema_ciel.2: Unlocks the physics assembler and the propeller bearing. Never consumed.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_rouages.1: "We are not leaving. We are waiting."
tooltip.kubejs.coeur_d_airain.2: Something far beneath the ground pulses with it.
tooltip.kubejs.sceau_forge.1: Rekindled by the Forge Great Work.
tooltip.kubejs.sceau_forge.2: Lets you forge diamond armor. Never consumed.
tooltip.kubejs.plaque_netherite.1: Replaces the netherite ingot for armor and weapons.
airain.portail.nether: The portal refuses to light. The secret of brass is missing.
airain.portail.end: The frame stays cold. The Sky Schematic is missing.
airain.renvoi: A force pushes you back: this world is still closed to you.
airain.chantier.waystones: The Waystone network has not been restored yet.
airain.chantier.gare: The imperial station has not been repaired yet.
airain.chantier.atelier: The enchanting workshop has not been reopened yet.
airain.journal.p1:
Journal of Octave Lanfrey
Engineer-in-Chief


Laboratory 7
Airain Empire
airain.journal.p2:
Day 1.

The Council approves the Core project. A single engine to power every city in the Empire.

They say it is the greatest work in our history.
airain.journal.p3:
Day 230.

The first capsules have been delivered. Volunteers queue at the door.

They say that in the metal, you are never cold and never afraid.
airain.journal.p4:
Day 398.

The guardians are ready. Each will watch over a memory until the return.

No one must rekindle the Core before the time has come.
airain.journal.p5:
Day 411.

I put my two apprentices to sleep in the back room. Their capsules do not lead to the Core.

They will wake without memories. It is better so: let them judge the Empire owing it nothing.

I leave them this journal, and enough to begin.
airain.journal.p6:
Day 412.

The orders have come: everyone to the Core. I will go down last, once my apprentices are asleep.

On the door they carved their motto:
"We are not leaving. We are waiting."
airain.ruine.page1:
Workshop 12, night shift.

The foreman says the Transfer doesn't hurt. Then why has nobody from the first convoy answered our letters?

I'm keeping the boiler warm, just in case.
airain.ruine.page2:
Order of the Council, to be posted in every workshop:

After departure, all machines shall remain under pressure.

Nobody told us for whom.
airain.ruine.page3:
If anyone finds this: I refuse.

I won't get into the capsule. They can keep my rations.

A few of us, up north, are saying no.

— a worker from Workshop 12
airain.sceau.ouvert: The seal gives way. The room opens.
airain.sceau.refus: This seal only answers to the %s.
airain.sceau.protege: A seal still protects this room.
airain.dortoir.page1:
Dormitory 3.

They told us to leave our belongings behind: "where you're going, you won't need them".

I kept my sister's photograph anyway.
airain.dortoir.page2:
The capsules are ready. The foreman looks relieved.

I can't sleep. The machines make a sound at night. Like breathing.
airain.dortoir.page3:
Last night here.

If the Transfer works, we'll wake up inside the Core, all together, forever.

If it doesn't… nobody will come to read this.
airain.distributeur.protege: The Empire's machines are sealed to the ground.
airain.refractaire.page1:
They said the Transfer was an honour. A place inside the Core, forever.

We saw the capsules come back empty. Not a body. Not a speck of ash.

We left that very night.
airain.refractaire.page2:
Camp rule: we never touch an Empire machine that still runs.

We strip them when they're dead, for the plating. Never before.

Some of them wake up when you come close.
airain.refractaire.page3:
The dark vial, we sell it to those who want to go down into the trial chambers.

It draws the evil eye. The chambers can feel it, and grow worse.

But what you find there is worth the price.
airain.station.p1:
Observation station no. 2.
Readings of Octave Lanfrey, Engineer-in-Chief.

Night 1. Clear sky. I come up here when the noise of the forges keeps me from thinking.
airain.station.p2:
Night 40. A violet light to the north, above the sealed fortress. It lasted an hour.

The next day, half of the engineers' quarter was empty. Ada Vael was gone.
airain.station.p3:
Night 52. The Council announces that the Refractories died in the marshes.

I saw their light go up, not south. I said nothing.
airain.station.p4:
Last night. The orders have arrived.

I am going down to prepare two capsules that lead nowhere. If the Empire is right, I will have been wrong for nothing. If it is wrong, someone will have to choose.

— O. L.
airain.essais.p1:
Test laboratory no. 3.

Trial 41: transfer of a worker's mind into a patrol automaton.

The automaton started up. It called for its daughter.
airain.essais.p2:
Trial 42: same protocol.

The automaton refused every order for three days. Then it obeyed. It never spoke again.

The Council deems the trial a success.
airain.essais.p3:
Conclusion sent to the Council:

a metal body is not enough. A larger vessel is needed, one that does not wear out.

Project "Core" is approved.
airain.refractaire.page4:
The Echo isn't magic. It's them. The ones who never reached the Core.

When you feel a chill near an amethyst crystal, someone is passing by.

Be polite.
airain.refractaire.page5:
We learned to capture the Echo in amethyst. A spell is a will you entrust to it.

The Empire's machines can't feel it. That's why we sometimes win.
airain.relais.p1:
Transfer relay no. 9 — incident report.

During cycle 212, the line broke under load. Part of the flow never reached the Core.
airain.relais.p2:
The lost flow did not dissipate. It spread around the relay.

Technicians speak of a chill, of whispers, and of crystals growing on the metal overnight.
airain.relais.p3:
Decision of Chancellor Héléna Strass: the phenomenon does not exist. The word "Echo" is banned from all reports.

Relay no. 9 is abandoned. Nobody is to approach it.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_resonance.1: A little of what the lost once were. It still hums.
tooltip.kubejs.diapason_echo.1: Struck at the heart of the Great Relay, it makes the Echo sing.
tooltip.kubejs.echo_primordial.1: What they were, freely given. Machines cannot feel it.
tooltip.kubejs.echo_primordial.2: Ingredient of the most powerful Echo spells.
airain.boss.reveil: The Echo starts to sing. Thousands of voices answer.
airain.boss.pas_ici: The tuning fork only resonates at the heart of the Great Relay.
airain.boss.libere: The voices fall silent, one by one. They leave you what they were.
airain.ada.p1:
My name is Ada Vesper. I was born Ada Vael.

I was an engineer at station no. 4, with my brother Elias. I signed the capsule blueprints. I know what they do.
airain.ada.p2:
Elias stayed. To him, I betrayed the Empire: he no longer says "my sister", only "Ada".

I left him a letter. He never came.

I took those who wanted to live, and we went north. We are the Refractories.
airain.ada.p3:
The Echo is stronger around broken relays. Strongest of all is the Great Relay, where the main line gave way.

Thousands of minds are stuck there. They scream without a sound.
airain.ada.p4:
I made a tuning fork: resonance fragments, an echo gem, a little gold.

Struck on the Great Relay's resonator, it will wake them. They will be mad with pain.
airain.ada.p5:
If someone frees them, they will entrust that person with what they are. A pure Echo, which machines cannot feel.

It is the only weapon that will reach those who sleep in the metal, if they ever wake.
airain.station.p5:
Someone slipped a letter under my door. Ada's handwriting.

I did not open it. I put it away in the collector's chest.

I do not know why I did not burn it.
airain.station.p6:
Cycle 211. Last entry.

My turn in the capsule is tomorrow. I asked to go first.

If anyone finds this report: never light the Core. They are still waiting, in there.
airain.lettre.p1:
Elias,

I know you don't want to speak to me anymore. Read this anyway.

I have seen the full Transfer blueprints. The capsules lead nowhere anyone lives.

Come with us. There is still time.
airain.lettre.p2:
I'm not asking you to betray the Empire. I'm asking you to live.

You are my brother, whatever you think.

I will wait for you in the north, for as long as it takes.

— Ada
airain.ada.p6:
Elias went into a capsule. I know it.

If he reached the Core, he sleeps with the Empire. If he got lost on the way, he sings with the Choir.

I don't know which I wish for more.

— A. V.
airain.chantier.pneumatique: The Empire's pneumatic network has not been reopened yet.
tooltip.kubejs.balise_defense.1: Siren lighthouse tower (3 × 3 ground, 8 high). Right-click: start an Empire assault (4 waves).
tooltip.kubejs.balise_defense.2: Sneak + right-click: set the arrival radius and show the circle.
airain.balise.rayon: Arrival radius: %s blocks. The red circle shows where they will appear.
airain.balise.appel: The beacon howls. Somewhere, machines turn toward you.
airain.balise.vague_ok: Wave %s repelled! The next one arrives in %s seconds.
airain.balise.victoire: The assault is repelled. The Empire withdraws… for now.
airain.balise.abandon: The beacon goes dark. The assault is abandoned.
airain.balise.reprise: You're back: wave %s starts again after the respite.
airain.balise.en_cours: An assault is under way. Sneak + right-click to abandon it.
airain.balise.pas_de_sol: No natural open ground on the circle: change the radius (sneak + right-click).
tooltip.kubejs.ferraille.1: Melts down in a furnace, or grinds in crushing wheels.
tooltip.kubejs.huile_machine.1: Pour it into the maintenance bench, or into an item drain.
tooltip.kubejs.rouage_brise.1: A mechanical press sets it straight again.
tooltip.kubejs.banc_entretien.1: Repairs like an anvil, with oil instead of experience.
tooltip.kubejs.banc_entretien.2: Right-click: screen (modules, oil). Repaired tools and weapons come out sharpened for 10 min.
tooltip.kubejs.table_enchantement.1: Offers the enchantments of books shelved in nearby chiseled bookshelves.
tooltip.kubejs.table_enchantement.2: You pick the enchantment and its level, up to the book's.
tooltip.kubejs.desenchanteur.1: Destroys an enchanted item and pulls one random enchantment into a book.
tooltip.kubejs.desenchanteur.2: Driven by a cog, it burns 500 mB of oil per level. With runic ink, it purges curses without destroying the item.
airain.mine.p1:
Gallery 7, forty metres under the plain.

We dig for the Core: copper, zinc, and more copper.

The foreman says it will need more than the whole earth holds.
airain.mine.p2:
The maintenance crawlers go down on their own now. They grease the rails and stitch the cables.

Nobody programmed them to.
airain.mine.p3:
Last shift. We all go up tomorrow for the Transfer.

I left my lamp lit at the end of the gallery. If I don't come back down, let it light someone else's way.
airain.prospecteur.p1:
To my sister, at the counter of the southern outpost.

I found a temple far older than the Empire. Its builders already loved traps and mechanisms.

Nothing new under the sun.
airain.prospecteur.p2:
I'm hiding my pay here. The Council says we won't need money after the Transfer.

Then why does it still count ours?
airain.prospecteur.p3:
If I don't come back, take the coins.

And don't step into a capsule before you hear from me.
airain.cargaison.p1:
Freighter "Stubborn", home port: the Western Quay.

Load: 40 tonnes of copper, 12 of zinc, 300 cogwheels.

Destination: the Core worksite.
airain.cargaison.p2:
Captain's note.

The Council requisitions the passengers too. All of them. They travel in the hold, asleep, and I am forbidden to wake them.
airain.cargaison.p3:
We turned out to sea tonight.

If the Core wants this cargo, let it come and fetch it from the bottom.

— Captain Morvan
airain.conseil.p1:
Council register, session 1.

A single engine will power every city. No more famine, no more winter.

The project is named the Core.
airain.conseil.p2:
Session 88.

The engineers report, beneath this fortress, a stone ring with empty eyes, older than the Empire. They say it leads elsewhere.

Chancellor Strass orders it sealed.
airain.conseil.p3:
Session 140.

The Core asks for more than metal.

Unanimous vote: the Transfer begins next cycle.
airain.profondeurs.p1:
Expedition 3, beneath the black rock.

A whole city, far older than us. Its people are gone. They left a great portal that leads nowhere.
airain.profondeurs.p2:
Here the Echo is stronger than anywhere else. The crystals sing when we fall silent.

I think these people made the same mistake as us, long before us.
airain.profondeurs.p3:
The keeper of this place hears everything.

Walk softly. And above all, do not speak of the Core.
airain.nether.p1:
Imperial expedition to the other world, day 3.

The heat melts the solder. We clad the machines in black bricks so they hold.
airain.nether.p2:
Day 19.

The blackened automatons guard the fortresses. They are ours, sent before us.

They no longer recognize our insignia.
airain.nether.p3:
Day 40.

The Infernal Guardian has woken. The Council wanted its core to feed ours.

We will not return.
airain.ciel.p1:
Hunter of the Council fleet, last log.

We crossed the stone ring. On the other side: purple towers that sing. The fugitives are not dead. They live here.
airain.ciel.p2:
Their beast brought down three of our ships. They called it with the Echo, and bound it to the black towers.

One of their children asked me where my mother sleeps. In the Core, I said. He cried.
airain.ciel.p3:
They say the Core does not keep souls. That it burns them.

I am out of ink, and I will not go home.

If you are reading this: give it nothing.
tooltip.kubejs.table_enchantement.3: An ancient tome adds one level to the book; applying it consumes one rune ink.
tooltip.kubejs.encre_runique.1: Goes into the Empire's enchanting table.
tooltip.kubejs.encre_runique.2: Consumed to apply the level unlocked by an ancient tome.
airain.cache.p1:
Cache no. 7, dug at night, far from the Empire's roads.

Enough to last a winter: tools, food, a few coins.

Patrols never search under the ground.
airain.cache.p2:
If you found the cross, one of ours trusted you.

Take what you need. Leave the rest for the next one.
airain.cache.p3:
Ada says the Core will run out of souls one day. That day, it will come for the last ones.

That day, we will be underground.
tooltip.kubejs.socle_trophee.1: Displays a boss trophy: its effect benefits the whole team, everywhere.
tooltip.kubejs.socle_trophee.2: Two identical trophies do not stack. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: settings (material, velvet, dome…).
tooltip.kubejs.pierre_fondation.1: Two blocks tall. Names a base: its name shows when entering its area.
tooltip.kubejs.pierre_fondation.2: Right-click: name and banner. Create wrench: set the area.
tooltip.kubejs.registre_fondations.1: Lists every foundation: name, coordinates, distance.
tooltip.kubejs.grand_etendard.1: The same standard on a six-block mast: a bigger banner, adjustable in length and width.
tooltip.kubejs.grand_etendard.2: Right-click: name, cloth, mast, fittings… Redstone: half-mast. Decorative mode: no title, not in the registry.
tooltip.kubejs.banniere_murale.1: Decorative banner on a rod, placed against a wall. Same cloth settings as the standards.
tooltip.kubejs.banniere_murale.2: Right-click: settings. A redstone signal rolls it up.
tooltip.kubejs.gabarit_banniere.1: Sneak + right-click a standard or banner: copies its look.
tooltip.kubejs.gabarit_banniere.2: Right-click another: applies the look, decorative mode included (name and motto are kept).
tooltip.kubejs.meule_fine.1: Maintenance bench module: 30% less oil per repair.
tooltip.kubejs.demultiplicateur.1: Maintenance bench module: 60% faster, but needs twice the stress.
tooltip.kubejs.graisseur.1: Maintenance bench module: pumps oil from a nearby tank.
airain.carte_refractaire.l1: Drawn by hand, in charcoal. A red cross.
airain.carte_refractaire.l2: "Dig under the cross. What lies beneath is ours."
airain.abri_nether.p1:
Third night in the lower forges. Eight steps here is a day's walk up there: the patrols won't follow us that fast.

Ada says the gate is beneath the Council's hall.
airain.abri_nether.p2: The abyss smiths let us through. They cough the same smoke we do. One of them showed me his hands: burned by the souls they're made to stoke.
airain.abri_nether.p3:
Tomorrow we go back up. If the gate opens, we leave for where the Echo sings loud enough to drown the noise of machines.

Leave the soul fire lit for those who follow.
airain.champ_bataille.p1: The walker came from the east at dawn. Three storeys of cast iron, a cannon for an arm. Our stakes were useless.
airain.champ_bataille.p2:
Mira called the Echo. I had never seen that: the ground turned white, crystal grew in the iron, and it fell.

She never came back from the crater.
airain.champ_bataille.p3:
We break camp tonight. They say there's a refuge, beyond a gate the Empire guards underground.

If you read this, keep the crate. We won't need it anymore.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_rouages.2: I keep the memory of the workshops.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_rouages.3: I was told: when they come back,
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_rouages.4: give them the plans of every machine.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_rouages.5: No one told me who would come back.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_marees.2: I keep the memory of the docks.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_marees.3: The volunteers sang as they climbed
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_marees.4: into the capsules. When the cables pulled,
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_marees.5: the song stopped. It is warm, down below.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_forge.2: I keep the memory of the soul forge.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_forge.3: The Core does not run on coal.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_forge.4: Every soul warms it a little,
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_forge.5: and a little less each day.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_vide.2: I keep the memory of the sealed ring.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_vide.3: Those who refused went through it.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_vide.4: The Chancellor ordered me to forget them.
tooltip.kubejs.fragment_vide.5: I cannot. There were too many of them.
airain.conseil.p4:
Session 141, behind closed doors.

Chancellor Strass recalls that the founder showed the way. Auguste Ferrand has slept inside his first factory for forty years, and it still runs.

This trial has no number. It never happened.
airain.patrouille.approche: An Empire patrol is coming from %s.
airain.patrouille.largage: Propellers above you… They are dropping from the sky!
airain.dirigeable.p1:
Log of the cruiser "Tireless", sky fleet.

Order from the Core, received on cycle 412: stay aloft and guard the sky until the return.

The living crew has joined the capsules. The automatons hold the ship.
airain.dirigeable.p2:
The automatons do not sleep. They grease the propellers, mend the envelope, circle the same clouds.

They cannot count years. I can. I am at forty.
airain.dirigeable.p3:
I will not go down. If someone comes aboard one day, let them know this ship still obeys the Core.

And that the Core never said it would give us back.

— The captain
airain.morgana1.p1:
The Relay went silent tonight. I don't know how many of us were transferred before the signal gave out. Forty, perhaps more.

They did not vanish. I still hear them, between two resonances, like a choir that has lost its score.
airain.morgana1.p2:
Ferrand calls it immortality. I call it a cage.

We leave for the Void tomorrow. Those still faithful to the Arcana follow me. The others will go back to the Factory.

— M. D.
airain.morgana2.p1:
The city holds. The stones here know neither rust nor Empire.

I did what had to be done so we would never be found. The Guardian of the Skies now watches over our gates.
airain.morgana2.p2:
I summoned it with my own hands, and I know that one day it will no longer tell an enemy from one of our own.

If anyone reads this, we are gone, or we have failed.

The Choir still sings. Listen to it.

— M. D.
airain.ada_morgana.p1:
Morgana,

your fragments arrived. My engineers don't understand what they are looking at, but I know a voice when I hear one.

You were right: the transfer does not kill, it imprisons.
airain.ada_morgana.p2:
I will not let my people become cogs for that man's eternity. The Sanctuary will stay closed to the Empire as long as I live.

If you find a way to free them, don't wait for me. Do it.

— Ada
airain.apprentie1.p1:
Morgana put a crystal in my hand and told me to be quiet.

After an hour, it turned cold. She smiled: "You've just met someone."
airain.apprentie2.p1:
You don't take the Echo, you feed it. Flowers, lava, newborn beasts.

What lives gives back a little of what the Empire stole from it.
airain.apprentie3.p1:
My first will was a light. It trembled, then it held all night.

Someone in there had agreed to help me.
airain.apprentie4.p1:
For the departure to the Void, Morgana opened the sky. She had never cast a ritual so great.

Her nose bled for three days.
airain.apprentie5.p1:
The little yellow one refuses to leave me. Morgana says it may have been a child, before.

I don't want to know. I named it Pip.
airain.apprentie6.p1: You don't wear the robe to protect yourself. You wear it so the lost recognise you.
airain.apprentie7.p1:
The night Morgana called the Sky Guardian, I was beside her.

The beast opened its eyes, and for a moment it did not know whom it should serve.

Neither did Morgana, I think.

— Sybille Arden
airain.elias1.p1:
Station No. 4. Today Chancellor Strass came to see the capsules, in the Emperor's name.

She read us his words: "Thanks to you, no one will ever be cold again."
airain.elias1.p2:
Ada didn't listen. She stared at her plans as if they were about to bite her.

That day I understood why we build.

— E. V.
airain.elias2.p1:
Ada left tonight, with twenty-three workers and the station's plans.

The Council speaks of desertion. I use the real word: treason.
airain.elias2.p2:
Chancellor Strass sent for me. She did not blame me for my sister. She kept me at the head of the station: the Empire needs men it can trust.

I will serve twice as well, for two.

— E. V.
airain.elias3.p1: The Chancellor sent me an order to sign: hunt down the Refractories of the north, seize their machines, bring them back to the Heart. Willingly or by force.
airain.elias3.p2:
Her messenger watched me sign. I signed without trembling.

Tonight my hands are shaking. It's only the cold.

— E. V.
airain.elias4.p1:
A letter from Ada, slipped under my door. She must have crossed every patrol to bring it.

I did not open it. I will not open it.
airain.elias4.p2:
I did not burn it either. I put it away in the collector's chest.

A soldier keeps evidence. That's all.

— E. V.
airain.helena1.p1:
I was twelve when I saw the first factory light up.

He was there, on the gangway, his hands black with soot. The whole town watched him the way you watch the sunrise.
airain.helena1.p2:
That day I knew a man could be a sun.

I have followed him ever since. I always will.
airain.helena2.p1:
He sent for me tonight. He no longer slept. He, of all men, was afraid of dying before he was done.

I held his hand until dawn.
airain.helena2.p2:
The others will never see this. For them he must remain the sun.

For me he will. Even if I am the one who has to carry it.
airain.helena3.p1:
He entered the factory today. The first of all, as he wished.

The gears began to beat in time with his heart. I wept. I never weep.
airain.helena3.p2: I will guard his door. I will guard his name. When the Empire wakes, it will find everything in order.
airain.helena4.p1:
The Refractories. The word is too gentle.

They are rust. They eat away at what he built while claiming to save it.
airain.helena4.p2: You do not argue with rust. You scrape it off, down to clean metal.
airain.helena5.p1:
Young Vael signed the order for the north. His own sister is among them.

He did not tremble. I have rarely seen loyalty so pure.
airain.helena5.p2: I did not have the courage to tell him the order says nothing about bringing them back alive.
airain.helena6.p1:
The engineers of relay No. 9 speak of voices in the crystals. An "Echo".

I ordered the word struck from the reports. What is not written does not exist.
airain.helena6.p2:
If the Empire must lie to stay standing, then the Empire will lie.

(the bottom of the page is burnt)
airain.helena7.p1:
… the last order has gone out. Everyone to the Heart …

… no capsule for me. I will go down beside him, into the factory …
airain.helena7.p2:
… may the sun never set …

— H. S.
airain.ferrand1.p1: … the boiler held all night. The whole street warmed itself against the workshop wall …
airain.ferrand1.p2:
… I want no one to be cold again. Never again. If a machine can do that, I will build the machine …

— A. F.
airain.ferrand2.p1: … the doctor says a year, perhaps two. The factory will run a hundred …
airain.ferrand2.p2: … it is not death I fear. It is leaving before I am done …
airain.ferrand3.p1:
Tomorrow I enter the factory. Héléna will guard the door.

If I am right, I will never die. They will follow me, one by one, and no one will be cold again.
airain.ferrand3.p2:
If I am wrong …

(the rest is burnt)
airain.morgana3.p1:
I woke a second guardian, in the citadel, around the Altar of Void. It guards the last fragment.

It will let through only whoever can defeat it. That one will have the strength to see it through.
airain.morgana3.p2:
I gave it my voice, so it would not be alone. It knows a single word, the only one I can still promise the Choir.

Soon.

— M. D.
airain.ada_fin.p1:
I am old now. Elias never came.

The Echo keeps the voices of those who fade away near the relays. I know it; I have listened to it long enough.
airain.ada_fin.p2:
So I sit here, against the resonator, and I wait. I promised him: as long as it takes.

If someone frees the Choir, I will be the last to leave. I would like to leave with my brother.

— Ada
airain.vael.p1:
Transfer station no. 4 — report by engineer Elias Vael.

Cycle 205. All capsules emptied on schedule. No failure of the collector.
airain.vael.p2:
Families ask where the bodies go. The Council answers: "into the Core".

I check the cables. They do not carry matter. They carry… something else.
airain.vael.p3:
Note from cycle 209.

Ada deserted last night, with twenty-three of the station's workers. The Council asked me whether I knew.

Ada told me nothing. Ada is nothing to the Empire anymore. She is nothing to me.
airain.vael.p4:
The collector readings never go down. What goes in never comes out.

The Core does not keep people's memories. It keeps the people.
airain.vael.p5:
Someone slipped a letter under my door. Ada's handwriting.

I did not open it. I put it away in the collector's chest.

I do not know why I did not burn it.
airain.vael.p6:
Cycle 211. Last entry.

My turn in the capsule is tomorrow. I asked to go first.

If anyone finds this report: never light the Core. They are still waiting, in there.
